text:
harper: customer reported runtime crash on Cloudflare Workers. stack: 
```
ReferenceError: process is not defined
    at Object.<anonymous> (node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs:14:10)
```
They did a plain `import { createClient } from 'redwood'` in an ESM worker and their bundler pulled our CJS artifact.

leo: yeah this is our package resolution problem. we don't currently expose a worker-specific entry so old bundler heuristics pick CJS. Workers have no Node APIs (no process, no Buffer, and `globalThis.crypto` instead of `require('crypto')`).

nina: suggested fixes: publish an ESM worker entry that avoids Node-only bits, and add a conditional exports map with a `worker` condition. e.g.:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This lets bundlers that understand the `worker` condition pick the safe build. Also document `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'` for manual fix.

harper: types? TS only supports one `types` entry per package.json. How do we keep typings for `redwood/worker` consumers?

leo: ship a main `index.d.ts` referenced by `types`, plus include a small `types-worker.d.ts` shipped in the package that does `declare module 'redwood/worker' { export * from 'redwood'; }`. That keeps consumers typed when importing the `/worker` path.

nina: runtime shim notes: use `globalThis.crypto` on the worker path. Guard Node-specific `require('crypto')` behind `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` so bundlers can tree-shake it out of the worker build. Also replace any `Buffer` usage with `Uint8Array` or `TextEncoder`/`TextDecoder` in the worker entry. Example pattern: 
```
let webcrypto;
if (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && globalThis.crypto?.subtle) {
  webcrypto = globalThis.crypto;
} else if (typeof process !== 'undefined') {
  webcrypto = require('crypto').webcrypto; // node-only
}
```
Be careful that the `require` branch is unreachable in Workers so bundlers drop it.

harper: CI reported `bundle:cloudflare` failing on master with `Could not resolve "crypto" in node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs`. We should add a Miniflare integration check to CI to catch this earlier.

build-bot: CI failure: job `bundle:worker` - assigning to @leo.

harper: action items: @leo open small PR adding `dist/index.worker.mjs` (worker-safe), update package.json exports to include `worker`, add `types-worker.d.ts` augmentation, and add a sample under `devex/samples/cloudflare/` demonstrating `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'`. I'll add a Miniflare test in `integration/cloudflare/` to CI.

leo: will do, aiming for minimal changes to avoid disturbing Node bundle paths. will include quick repro steps using `miniflare --modules`.

nina: also add a short README blurb telling customers how to fix the immediate issue: either `import 'redwood/worker'` or upgrade to SDK version that includes the worker export.

harper: thanks team. this should reduce edge customer crashes. :+1:
